column2: [intro]
A red nose, giant shoes
They tell jokes that don't amuse
Their makeup is way too thick
Clowns, I've had enough, they make me sick
I don't really like clowns
With their smiles that seem so fake
They give me the chills
Clowns, they give me the shakes
They juggle with colorful balls
But for me, it's no fun at all
Their grimaces give me the chills
Clowns, what a weird thrill
I don't really like clowns
With their pranks that fall flat
They try to make me laugh, but I fear
Clowns, they're just not my sphere
[ solo ]
But I know some people adore
Clowns, they laugh and more
So, I respect their art, even if it's not for me
Maybe one day, I'll find them funny, we'll see
[ outro ]
